screen.mapperzones.title: Mapper Zones
screen.mapperzones.name: Name
message.mapperzones.wand_given: Zone wand given. Use it on two blocks, then /mapperzones create <name>.
message.mapperzones.select_points: Select two points with the zone wand first.
message.mapperzones.zone_exists: A zone with the name '%s' already exists.
message.mapperzones.invalid_shape: Shape must be box, sphere, or cylinder.
message.mapperzones.invalid_event: Event must be enter, exit, or stay.
message.mapperzones.variable_too_long: Variable name or value is too long.
message.mapperzones.invalid_scope: Scope must be global or player.
message.mapperzones.first_point: Mapper Zones: first point set to %s. Select the second point.
message.mapperzones.second_point: Mapper Zones: second point set to %s. Run /mapperzones create <name>.
screen.mapperzones.zone_count: Zones: %s • Select a zone to edit
screen.mapperzones.condition_examples_mo: Also: team <name>, time >= 13000, weather rain, dim minecraft:overworld
screen.mapperzones.variable_examples: Variable: var global score >= 5  |  var player quest == started
screen.mapperzones.condition_help_intro: Click an example to append it to the conditions field.
screen.mapperzones.condition_help_vars: Player properties use the player. prefix: health, max_health, food, name, gamemode, x, y, z.
screen.mapperzones.condition_help_ops: Operators: == != > < >= <=, logic: && ||, grouping: ( ). Quote string values.
screen.mapperzones.condition_help_legacy: Legacy item, team, time, weather, dim and var conditions remain supported.
screen.mapperzones.legacy_action_note: Legacy whitespace syntax is also supported for known action types.
screen.mapperzones.editor_condition_hint: One expression per line. Example: player.health >= 10 && player.food > 0
screen.mapperzones.editor_action_hint: One action per line. Use Syntax help for categories and examples.
screen.mapperzones.action_help_hint: Examples and action categories are available in Syntax help.
screen.mapperzones.action_helper.command: The command text follows command:. Player placeholders are expanded.
Use a valid Minecraft command; do not add a leading slash.
screen.mapperzones.action_helper.sound_d: Play a sound at the player.
screen.mapperzones.action_helper.sound_n: Format: sound:<sound_id> <volume> <pitch> (volume and pitch are optional).
screen.mapperzones.action_helper.freeze_: The number is the duration in ticks.
screen.mapperzones.action_helper.restore: A saved inventory must exist for that player.
screen.mapperzones.action_helper.reset_d: Reset a zone's one-time trigger history.
screen.mapperzones.invalid_shape_value: Shape must be BOX, SPHERE, or CYLINDER
screen.mapperzones.help.player_props_1: health, max_health, food, saturation, level, experience
screen.mapperzones.help.player_props_2: name, uuid, team, gamemode, x, y, z, dimension
screen.mapperzones.help.player_props_3: on_ground, sprinting, sneaking, alive (use the player. prefix)
screen.mapperzones.help.global_vars: Global variables use global.name, for example global.score or global.round.
screen.mapperzones.help.player_vars: Player-specific variables use player.name, for example player.quest or player.rank.
screen.mapperzones.help.logic_desc: && means AND; || means OR; use parentheses ( ) to group expressions.
screen.mapperzones.help.quotes_desc: Put text values in quotes, for example: player.name == "Steve"
screen.mapperzones.help.item_desc: Passes when the player has at least one diamond in their inventory.
screen.mapperzones.help.item_details: Use the item's namespaced ID, such as minecraft:iron_ingot or minecraft:apple.
screen.mapperzones.help.team_desc: Passes when the player belongs to a scoreboard team named builders. The name must match exactly.
screen.mapperzones.help.time_desc: Checks the world's day-time counter (0–23999): 0 is sunrise, 6000 noon, 12000 sunset, 18000 midnight.
screen.mapperzones.help.time_details: Example: time >= 13000 is true during the later night portion, until the counter wraps around.
screen.mapperzones.help.weather_desc: Use clear for no rain, rain for ordinary rain without thunder, or thunder for a thunderstorm.
screen.mapperzones.help.dimension_desc: Other examples: dim minecraft:the_nether and dim minecraft:the_end. Use the full dimension ID.
screen.mapperzones.help.legacy_desc: The first word selects the scope (global or player), followed by the variable name, comparison operator, and value.
screen.mapperzones.help.legacy_details: For new configurations, the expression style is usually easier to combine: global.score >= 5 && player.quest == "started"
